notes: Only preset names are printed; the Data List does not print preset parameter values.

preset_number is the 0-based position in the printed list. The MIDI "Preset Number" parameter that follows each Type parameter (e.g. Reverb Preset Number, Variation Preset Number) is assumed to index this order, but the PDF does not state that explicitly (unverified).
type_as_printed keeps the Preset List spelling (e.g. "U.S. Combo", "Multi-band Comp", "Beat Repeat (even)"); effect_type is the Effect Type List name.
